title: Connection state machine under replay
notes: 500 seeded random legal walks driven through the real transitionConnection with the same Prisma-shaped fake pipeline.test.ts uses (src/lib/connect/pipeline-fake-client.ts). Complements pipeline-shared.test.ts, which enumerates the 15x15 table statically: this exercises the DATABASE half — the guarded update, the atomic event write, and the student-actor narrowing — over long sequences rather than single steps. Every walk also attempts one illegal move at every step, and every legal-but-not-student-legal move is attempted with a student actor.
